C-R9-GOVERNANCE-SIMPLIFY-327.IntentSummary: Remove duplicate post-merge verification and brittle design ritual while preserving one complete PR project check, risk-scoped GRACE and the existing build-once release contract.

MustContain.Text: catalog has no usable demo mappings

T-001.Title: kafedra-release: reduce ordinary CI duplication without changing release

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: PR/manual Проверка runs locked install, check, docs, unit/integration and smoke exactly once.
Push main runs only locked install and smoke, with no duplicate check/docs/unit suite.
Specialized browser/offline/systemd/recovery workflows remain outside ordinary CI.
Release workflow stays byte-unchanged and its existing build-once/install/update/rollback tests remain green.

T-002.Title: kafedra-release: remove automatic post-merge GRACE repetition

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: GRACE runs automatically for pull requests changing .grace/** and remains manually dispatchable.
GRACE no longer subscribes to push main and therefore cannot repeat contract/database after a successful exact-head PR gate.
Database gate remains risk-selected by active M-DATABASE/M-BACKUP/M-MIGRATION-RUNNER scope.

T-003.Title: kafedra-tests: replace brittle design ritual with semantic checks

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Required design/motion/skill artifacts and reduced-motion/no-motion guidance remain fail-closed.
Reference catalog requires at least one usable mapping and the redistribution boundary, not an exact count.
UI changes are no longer rejected because a plan omits a fixed five-role sequence or because only the affected layout is tested.
Tests prove both permissive refactors and true contract loss.

T-004.Title: kafedra-release: align operator/developer docs and retire factual backlog

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AGENTS, README, CODEX_AGENTS and VALIDATION describe full PR evidence plus post-merge smoke and risk-based role selection.
Only confirmed stale release/probe/archive items are closed, with evidence comments and no product issue closed by age alone.

T-005.Title: kafedra-tests: integration audit on exact PR head

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: npm run check, docs, all project unit/integration tests, smoke and GRACE gate pass on one exact PR head.
No polling, workflow_run fan-out, new workflow or release artifact rebuild path is introduced.
